final: SELECT SUM(player_count) as total_count, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(share - (SELECT avg_sh FROM avg_share)) as avg_excess FROM (WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.throws, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.player_id) as player_count FROM player_award pa JOIN player p ON pa.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.throws), shares AS (SELECT throws, player_count, player_count * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(player_count) FROM hand_counts) as share FROM hand_counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_sh FROM shares) SELECT throws, player_count, share FROM shares, avg_share WHERE share > avg_sh)
